## Historical audit — H0042

**Source for all citations:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/runs/codex_parallel_05/lanes/codex_parallel_05_lane0/codex_parallel_05_lane0_shared/hint_gen/claude-code-by-agents-recursive-delegation/trajs.json`. Offsets below identify the supplied decoded observations.

**Inferred goal:** enable recursive delegation in a multi-agent chat system, including returning a sub-agent’s result to its caller. This is a **teacher-only guidance trace**, not a student implementation trace. The teacher described its repository review as read-only; its permitted artifact was a guidance file.

| Evidence | Observed operation or result |
|---|---|
| Main agent events 1–2, chars [0,584) and [0,76367) | Read a reference diff proposing handler, Anthropic adapter, provider-type and registry changes. The diff is input inspected by the teacher, **not evidence it was applied**. |
| Events 6–13, chars [0,23565), [0,5479), [0,9304), [0,13354) | Independently read the existing handler, types, registry and adapter. The handler visibly invokes a provider once; the adapter’s shown stream parser handles text and termination, supporting the teacher’s diagnosis of a missing delegation round trip. |
| Events 14–23, including event 15 [0,8236) and event 19 [0,24096) | Searched request flow and tests and inspected related files. The existing screenshot test expects top-level `data.content`; the reference diff changes that representation. This is a concrete compatibility concern, not a demonstrated test failure. |
| Events 24–25, chars [0,8392) and [0,8295) | Wrote `/tmp/hint_output.md`; the tool reported successful creation. Guidance proposed matched tool-use/result IDs, recursive execution, path-local cycle detection, cancellation and mocked stream tests. These are **proposals**, not executed updates. |
| Event 26 [0,8243); top-level metadata [0,12180) | The teacher reported no source edits, tests, branch or commit. Session metadata records successful completion, not implementation correctness. No student receipt or adoption is visible. |

**Outcome and uncertainty:** Guidance artifact creation succeeded; the implementation outcome is **unknown**, with no visible test run, formal correctness result, algorithm failure, or technical interruption. An empty source patch is consistent with the stated guidance-only role, not proof that a student’s patch was empty. The reference diff’s actual runtime behavior and screenshot compatibility remain unverified. Availability of the guide alone does not establish that any student received or used it.

**Lessons:** Transferably, distinguish a proposed tool-call round trip from an observed execution and test compatibility at existing boundaries. Task-specific concerns include NDJSON attribution, Anthropic stream fragments and the screenshot message shape. No scene was constructed or rendered here; object count, materials, connections, pose, camera, lighting and render quality are not applicable or visually evidenced.
